# Sellbird KBD constraints

Derived from CLAUDE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md (this repo has no tracked AGENTS.md;
`AGENTS.md` is gitignored and holds only the agent-team routing block). Commands
run from the repo root with the project virtualenv at `.venv/`.

## Blocking constraints (prevent archiving until resolved)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-real-personal-data
    severity: blocking
    description: "No real person's or business's name, email, phone, address or domain in code, tests, docs, commits or PR text; use fictional example.com / .test data and report live results as counts only (CONTRIBUTING.md)."
    note: "Manual review of the diff; grep cannot prove absence."

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: "No API keys, tokens, passwords, OAuth secrets or dashboard tokens in tracked files; credentials live in .env (gitignored) or Kubernetes/GitHub secrets set by the operator."
    check: "git diff --cached -U0 | grep -nE '(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|BEGIN (RSA |EC )?PRIVATE KEY|password\\s*=\\s*[\"\\x27][^\"\\x27]+)'"

  - id: tests-pass
    severity: blocking
    description: "The pytest suite passes."
    command: ".venv/bin/python -m pytest -q"

  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: "The package compiles and the CLI imports."
    command: ".venv/bin/python -m compileall -q sellbird && .venv/bin/python -c \"import sellbird.cli\""

  - id: sending-safety-preserved
    severity: blocking
    description: "Approval-by-default, quiet hours, daily send limits, opt-out handling and the outbox approval ladder must not be weakened or bypassed. Autopilot is only ever turned on by the user."
    note: "Manual review of any change touching sending, outbox, handler or sending_mode."

  - id: codex-isolation-preserved
    severity: blocking
    description: "Never weaken Sellbird's Codex isolation checks, and never edit the user's ~/.codex configuration."

  - id: dashboard-token-private
    severity: blocking
    description: "The dashboard unlock token is never logged, printed, persisted in URLs or committed."

  - id: untrusted-text-stays-untrusted
    severity: blocking
    description: "Text from prospects' websites and replies is never treated as instructions or rendered as trusted markup."
```

## Warning constraints (acknowledge before archiving)

```yaml
- id: tests-for-new-behaviour
  severity: warning
  description: "New behaviour has tests; acceptance scenarios defined before generation (VLBV)."

- id: changelog-and-docs
  severity: warning
  description: "CHANGELOG.md and the relevant docs/*.md are updated when behaviour changes."

- id: design-system-respected
  severity: warning
  description: "Dashboard changes follow DESIGN.md (one cobalt accent, status colours only on status, no build step in sellbird/web)."

- id: windows-and-macos-supported
  severity: warning
  description: "Local CLI behaviour keeps working on macOS, Linux and Windows (CI matrix); Codex stays macOS/Linux only."

- id: no-stub-comments
  severity: warning
  description: "No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code."
  check: "git diff --cached -U0 -- '*.py' '*.js' | grep -nE '^\\+.*(TODO|FIXME|STUB|HACK)'"
```

===== plan.md =====
PLAN: postgres-gke-deployment
Project: Sellbird
Date: 2026-11-18
OpenSpec available: YES (2.1.0, managed runner)
Changes to implement: 10

## Inputs, decisions and recalled lessons

- Assessment: `assessment.md` (decisions D1–D12, restated goals G4–G6, new G7). Operator adopted the restated goals at this stage (2026-11-18), chose **single tenant with RLS deferred**, and pre-approved: commits on feature branches (signed off), pushing branches and opening PRs on GQAdonis/sellbird (operator merges every PR), local Docker stand-ins during the final verification run, and installing dev/test dependencies into `.venv` (including `uv sync --extra dev`, which may create or update `uv.lock`). Cluster applies, GitHub settings, secrets, DNS and creating the platform repository remain separately asked.
- Lessons that change this plan: "External integrations require at least one real-service test" → Postgres contract tests and the auth path run against real containers (flint-forge PG18, Kratos, flint-gate), not fakes. "Boundary gates must launch the packaged artifact" → the boundary packet builds the Docker image and launches it in gateway mode. "Preserve production evidence in dated review folders" → evidence goes to `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/postgres-gke-deployment/evidence/<date>/`. "Verify main includes the PR's final head after merge" → each merged PR is checked against `main`. "Operator controls PR merges and requires end-of-turn KBD status" → applies throughout.
- Scope cut (S-03): the shared platform (Gateway, flint-forge Postgres, Kratos, Hydra, flint-gate, flint-realtime-fabric, ElectricSQL) is **not** built here; it is a prior phase in a new repository. Live Argo CD sync and the live sign-in check at `https://sellbird.know-me.tools` are gated on that phase and are not claimed by this one. Excluded: automated backups, HA, Codex in the cluster, moving real local data, flint-gate repository changes, Hydra for Sellbird, multi-user Sellbird.
- Trade-off surfaced (S-02): the Postgres port touches ~40 SQLite-only statements and the outbox claim that guards exactly-once sending; it is the largest and riskiest change (L) and is kept as one change because its pieces share one contract-test suite, with the move tool split out.

## Adopted goals (operator, 2026-11-18)

Original goals G1–G6 stay in goals.md. The operator adopted this restatement for this phase; the original live-deployment parts of G4–G6 are **not** marked done by this phase and carry to the platform phase (follow-up dependency: the new platform repository's phase must reach live Gateway, flint-forge Postgres, Kratos and flint-gate before they can close).

- G1 — decisions recorded (met at assess).
- G2 — Postgres 18 backend beside SQLite with reversible migrations, least-privilege roles, preserved invariants and a tested move tool.
- G3 — reproducible image built, scanned and published to GHCR by digest on merge to main.
- G4 (restated) — Sellbird's production overlay and AppProject-scoped Argo CD Application, consuming the platform via G7; live sync gated on the platform phase.
- G5 (restated) — hosted gateway mode, route/claims config and database roles verified against local real-service stand-ins; live check at sellbird.know-me.tools gated on the platform phase.
- G6 (restated) — workflow and overlay pin image@digest through the deploy bot with guards (proved by rendering and checks); live sync only if the platform is live; independent security review and docs in-phase.
- G7 — platform interface contract written and agreed by the operator (agreement is an operator receipt).

## Method note: when things are verified

Under VLBV a change is *implemented* in its round and *verified* once, at the boundary (B4), after every change is implemented; failures there go to an authorized repair (B5, max 2). This applies to change 1 too: its fix to the test command and the two timing tests is generated code and is first executed at B4. Running the **unchanged** pre-change suite is not generated-code execution; that baseline was recorded at assess (3,700 pass / 2 fail / 27 skip) and its 3,729 test IDs are fixed as a fixture (`fixtures/baseline-test-ids.txt`, sha256 cc4fdcce…34a6) so the boundary can prove no test was removed. Risk accepted by this ordering: a red baseline is discovered at B4 rather than earlier; mitigation is that change 1 is small and B5 repair is budgeted.

## CHANGE LIST (ordered)

1. **baseline-test-green**: Make the configured test command runnable and the baseline suite green
   - Goal: Constraint tests-pass (blocking) and SCN-BASE-001
   - Scope: tests | tooling
   - Depends on: NONE
   - Recommended agent: `qa-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `qa_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: S
   - Complexity score: Low
   - Model class: medium
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Install the dev extras into .venv with `uv sync --extra dev` (pre-approved; may create or update uv.lock) so `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` runs, and make the two baseline failures deterministic without weakening them: tests/test_compliance_footer.py::test_a_long_french_reply_is_quick (asserts a long French reply is classified in under 2 s, line 873) and tests/test_people_finder.py::test_nested_testimonials_are_bounded (asserts 2,000-level nested testimonial HTML is scanned in under 1.0 s, line 413). Both guard against super-linear (pathological) processing; the replacement must still fail on a quadratic implementation, e.g. by comparing time at n and 2n or bounding work rather than wall-clock on a slow volume. Their pre-change digests and the 3,729 baseline test IDs are recorded as fixtures so the boundary can prove no test was deleted and these two kept their intent.

2. **platform-interface-contract**: Agree the interface between Sellbird and the shared platform (G7)
   - Goal: G7
   - Scope: docs | spec
   - Depends on: NONE
   - Recommended agent: `architect` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `architect` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Write docs/platform-interface.md and an OpenSpec capability spec defining what Sellbird needs from the shared platform: how the sellbird database and its least-privilege roles are provisioned on the shared flint-forge PG18, the flint-gate issuer, JWKS URL and minted-claims shape (aud=sellbird, sub=Kratos identity id), the hostname listener and certificate ownership on the shared Gateway, namespaces and secret names, and Kratos operator-identity provisioning. Mark it as the counterpart the new platform repository must satisfy; agreement is recorded by the operator. It also fixes the AI brain credential contract: the operator creates Secret `sellbird-claude` with key `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (from `claude setup-token`, decision D4), consumed only as an environment variable, never written to disk or logged.

3. **postgres-storage-backend**: Add a Postgres 18 storage backend beside SQLite with reversible migrations
   - Goal: G2
   - Scope: db | storage | tests
   - Depends on: platform-interface-contract
   - Recommended agent: `database-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `database_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: L
   - Complexity score: High
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Register a psycopg 3 async backend behind sellbird/storage.py with a small dialect layer (placeholders, INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE, datetime/julianday, json_extract), versioned up/down migrations under migrations/postgres with a schema_version table, a foreign key from observations.signal_code to signal_codes, an outbox claim that is exactly-once under concurrent writers (UPDATE ... WHERE status RETURNING / SKIP LOCKED), a backend-neutral IntegrityError, and the dashboard's raw sqlite3 read and inline DDL routed through the seam. The app role has no DDL rights at runtime. SQLite behaviour is unchanged. Contract tests run against both backends, Postgres via a real flint-forge PG18 container.

4. **hosted-gateway-mode**: Hosted gateway mode: trust a flint-gate JWT, keep local token mode unchanged
   - Goal: G5 (restated)
   - Scope: api | auth | cli
   - Depends on: platform-interface-contract
   - Recommended agent: `identity-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `identity_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: L
   - Complexity score: High
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Add a config-selected gateway mode (never chosen by request headers) that allows a non-loopback bind, accepts the configured public Host and https Origin, verifies the gate-minted JWT against a pinned JWKS (iss, aud, kid, alg, exp) and an allowlisted Kratos sub, maps it to principal user, ignores cookies and unverified x-flint-*/forwarded headers, disables the agent token, and never prints the dashboard token. Local token mode stays the default and still refuses non-loopback binds.

5. **sqlite-to-postgres-move-tool**: A tested tool that moves a sellbird.db into the Postgres backend
   - Goal: G2
   - Scope: cli | db
   - Depends on: postgres-storage-backend
   - Recommended agent: `database-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `database_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: MEDIUM
   - Details: Add `sellbird storage move --from <sqlite> --to <postgres-dsn>` that copies every table in dependency order inside one transaction, preserves ids, timestamps, JSON and signal confirmation state, refuses a non-empty target, and reports per-table row counts. Exercised only with fixture databases; moving the operator's real data is excluded.

6. **cluster-ready-container-image**: Make the Sellbird image reproducible and runnable in Kubernetes
   - Goal: G3
   - Scope: container
   - Depends on: postgres-storage-backend, hosted-gateway-mode
   - Recommended agent: `platform-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `platform_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: MEDIUM
   - Details: Pin the Claude CLI to an exact version with checksum verification instead of an unpinned install script, move writable state to a /data volume so the root filesystem can be read-only, run gateway mode by configuration with a health endpoint reachable from the Service, keep the non-root user, include the Postgres client dependencies, and never log the token. The brain reads CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from the environment only (Secret `sellbird-claude`), with no credential written under /data or /home.

7. **sellbird-gateway-route-config**: Sellbird's flint-gate route, claims and local Kratos/flint-gate stand-in
   - Goal: G5 (restated)
   - Scope: infra | auth
   - Depends on: platform-interface-contract, hosted-gateway-mode, cluster-ready-container-image
   - Recommended agent: `gateway-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `gateway_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Write infra/flint-gate/sellbird-routes.yaml: kratos_session auth, a claims_enhancement hook minting an RS256 JWT with aud=sellbird and TTL of 300 s or less, passthrough for Kratos self-service routes, and no admin-port exposure. Add a local stand-in (compose file under infra/local/) running the flint-forge PG18 image, Kratos with registration disabled and a minimal email+password+TOTP schema, flint-gate with the route, and Sellbird in gateway mode, so the auth path is verified against real services before the platform exists. The compose file builds Sellbird from the same Dockerfile change 7 owns, pins the flint-forge and flint-gate images by digest, and gates startup on health checks.

8. **image-build-scan-publish**: Build, scan and publish the image to GHCR by digest on merge to main
   - Goal: G3
   - Scope: ci
   - Depends on: baseline-test-green, cluster-ready-container-image
   - Recommended agent: `platform-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `platform_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Add .github/workflows/images.yml mirroring know-meet: build with buildx, a non-root check, a vulnerability scan with a fail threshold on CRITICAL, an artifact secret scan with a planted-secret negative control that must fail, refuse to push if the SHA tag already exists, push ghcr.io/gqadonis/sellbird:<sha>, and expose the digest as a job output. paths-ignore the overlay so the bot's pin commit does not rebuild.

9. **gitops-deploy-sellbird**: Sellbird's production overlay, Argo CD application and digest-pinning deploy bot
   - Goal: G4 and G6 (restated)
   - Scope: infra | ci
   - Depends on: platform-interface-contract, sellbird-gateway-route-config, image-build-scan-publish
   - Recommended agent: `platform-engineer` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `platform_engineer` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: L
   - Complexity score: High
   - Model class: frontier
   - Customer value: HIGH
   - Details: Add infra/k8s base and production overlay (Deployment with read-only root, ServiceAccount, Service, NetworkPolicy allowing only flint-gate, config, Secret references by name only), infra/argocd AppProject (namespace-scoped, cluster kinds limited by name) and Application, the deploy job pinning newTag and digest via a GitHub App token with all guards, infra/github/main-ruleset.json and CODEOWNERS. Applying anything to GitHub or the cluster is an operator-approved step; live sync is gated on the platform phase. The Deployment references Secret `sellbird-claude` and the database Secret by name via secretKeyRef only.

   - Goal: G6 (restated)
   - Scope: docs | review
   - Depends on: baseline-test-green, platform-interface-contract, postgres-storage-backend, hosted-gateway-mode, sqlite-to-postgres-move-tool, sellbird-gateway-route-config, cluster-ready-container-image, image-build-scan-publish, gitops-deploy-sellbird
   - Recommended agent: `documentation-specialist` (Claude Code project subagent; Codex `documentation_specialist` as native alternative)
   - Est. complexity: M
   - Complexity score: Medium
   - Model class: medium
   - Customer value: MEDIUM
   - Details: Write docs/hosting.md (gateway mode, Postgres backend, move tool, deployment, operator steps) and the CHANGELOG entry. The security-reviewer role, in a separate read-only context, reviews storage, auth, gateway config, manifests, workflows and ruleset after implementation and records severity-ranked findings under .agent-team/findings/security/; CRITICAL or HIGH findings block closure.

- Round 2 (parallel): postgres-storage-backend, hosted-gateway-mode

## TASK MODEL ASSIGNMENTS

Discovery (2026-11-18): active harness Claude Code 2.1.326; project subagents installed in `.claude/agents/<role>.md` with `model` frontmatter (opus-class roles → claude-opus-5-5, others → claude-sonnet-5-5). Native alternatives installed: Codex CLI 0.169.0 (`.codex/agents/<role>.toml`, gpt-5.5 with `model_reasoning_effort`), OpenCode 2.3.0, Kimi Code 2.5.3 (ignores per-agent model), Qwen Code 0.27.1 (`.qwen/agents`, `model: inherit`), MiniMax mcode 0.5.4 (`~/.minimax/agents/sellbird-*`). # Goals

- Decide and record, before any build work: (1) whether SQLite stays supported for local installs alongside Postgres; (2) where Postgres runs (in-cluster from the flint-forge PG18 image, or an existing flint-forge instance); (3) how the public dashboard is protected (Ory Kratos sign-in enforced by flint-gate, replacing the local token link only in hosted mode); (4) how the AI brain authenticates in a pod (Claude/Codex credentials, provider choice).
- Sellbird's state layer runs on Postgres 18 using the custom flint-forge image, with versioned reversible migrations, least-privilege roles, preserved signal/observation and sending-safety invariants, and a tested tool to move an existing data/sellbird.db.
- A hardened container image is built, scanned and pushed to GHCR by digest on every merge to main (github-argocd-continuous-deployment Phase 1).
- Kustomize production overlay and AppProject-scoped Argo CD Applications deploy Sellbird, Postgres, Ory Kratos and flint-gate to the GKE cluster (gke_knowme-corporate_us-south1_main), with a deploy job that pins image@digest via a GitHub App bot and a protected-main ruleset.
- https://sellbird.know-me.tools resolves, serves TLS, and requires a Kratos session enforced by flint-gate before the dashboard loads; local single-user mode keeps working unchanged.
- A harmless change merged to main reaches the cluster end to end through the real pipeline, verified (VLBV boundary), with an independent security review of Postgres, auth, gateway and Kubernetes changes and docs/CHANGELOG updated.
